cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project(core_jni LANGUAGES C CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

# Generated by package_aar.sh
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core_paths.cmake")
  include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core_paths.cmake")
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED CORE_A_PATH OR NOT EXISTS "${CORE_A_PATH}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "CORE_A_PATH missing. Run package_aar.sh / build_android.sh first.")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED CORE_INCLUDE OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${CORE_INCLUDE}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "CORE_INCLUDE missing.")
endif()

add_library(core_jni SHARED core_jni.cpp)
target_include_directories(core_jni PRIVATE "${CORE_INCLUDE}")
target_link_libraries(core_jni PRIVATE "${CORE_A_PATH}" log)
